title: Affine coefficient ideal for containment of a finite locally free subscheme
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring [def-pc-scheme], let $B$ be an $R$-algebra that is finite projective as an $R$-module, and let $J\subseteq B$ be an ideal. Let $K\subseteq R$ be the ideal generated by all $\varphi(j)$ with $j\in J$ and $\varphi\in\operatorname{Hom}_R(B,R)$. Then for every ring map $R\to R'$, the image of $J$ in $B\otimes_R R'$ is zero if and only if the image of $K$ in $R'$ is zero.
